selection_rationale: Sampling-mode check (R3d, frozen in robustness_plan.md): fixed-time count-matched mothers from the dense-snapshot bank 0b0d50e0b1a4711a at t=10000 with defector count in [80,140] (5% equivalent 110 +/- 30, selected for yield without touching any continuation outcome), 24 smallest-seed mothers; the same three core arms. Readout: sign of the paired medium-minus-small contrast under an alternative, non-crossing mother sampling mode.
interpretation: fate endpoints for direction-controlled displacement vectors; mother-level paired analysis against the same mothers' original arm
